newsitem.title: USA: TWA sets five-day systemwide ticket sale.
newsitem.headline: TWA sets five-day systemwide ticket sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Monday it set a five-day systemwide sale, reducing domestic fares by up to 55 percent and international ticket prices by up to 44 percent.

TWA said its domestic sale is based on its structural 21-day advance purchase, with additional savings for students and seniors. The domestic locations include Toronto, Canada, but exclude Honolulu and San Juan, Puerto Rico.
Internationally, the sale fares are available in trans-Atlantic markets, except Lisbon, Tel Aviv and Riyadh.
